title: Teenarazzi Server Modpack
description: This is a small mudpack for a private server with me and some friends, feel free to download this if you like vanilla+ mods
body: Level up your Minecraft experience with this insane modpack! Packed with performance boosters like Sodium, Lithium, and Indium, plus QoL mods like AppleSkin, Xaero’s Minimap/World Map, Waystones, and Sophisticated Backpacks. Dive into epic adventures with Dungeons & Taverns, Terralith, Cherished Worlds, and a ton of customization with Ears, Trinkets, and more. Whether you’re mining with Veinminer, exploring with Nature’s Compass, or just chilling with full bright and dynamic lights, this pack’s got you covered. Smooth, fun, and hella immersive.
